correctness.rationale: For simple C_n with n>=5, every vertex outside L has nonempty neighboring-L signature iff cyclic 000 is absent. A repeated nonempty signature for two zeros is necessarily shared singleton central 1 in 00100; similarly reverse complement side uses 111 and 11011. Alternating zero/one runs each have length 1 or 2; permitted run transitions yield two explicit transfer matrices with determinant polynomials P_A=1-tz²-t²z³-t²z⁴-t²z⁵-t³z⁶ and P_B=1-tz²-t²z⁴-(t²+t³)z⁵-t³z⁶-t⁴z⁸. The cyclic trace identity -z d_z log det(I-T) counts vertex-labelled words with correct n/k root factors. At t=1 each supported exponent set has gcd 1, so unique simple minimal positive pole; P_B(alpha)-P_A(alpha)=alpha³(1-alpha²-alpha⁵)>0 for alpha<2/3, implying beta>alpha and b_n/a_n~(alpha/beta)^n. Independent direct neighborhood enumeration over all 2^n masks for n=5..13 agrees with both univariate determinant coefficients; the bivariate formal proof is the transfer-matrix argument, not these finite tests.
